actualGaps: Exact built-byte browser QA remains pending across phone, desktop, narrow, tablet, ultrawide, themes, text zoom and keyboard. Source tests do not prove visual acceptance.
Review configurations share family-specific planning controls; they are not seventy-five independent live product implementations.
Voice has text-only start/pause/resume/end and illustrative preference choices. No microphone, real voice, audio preview or call service exists.
Persistent assistant computer/teach/skills/routines/templates/notifications are local instruction and readiness previews, not live execution or access. No support request ID exists to copy.
Shared-output preview exports a real local JSON draft only. PDF generation, actual published snapshots and owner share controls require a real supported output.
Media templates offer local reference/ratio/frame-role/quality/audio-brief preview; no image edits, video generation, upscale, looping or provider upload occurs.
Team/license/invitation/usage/retention previews do not establish entitlements or mutate organizations.
Specialized legal pages contain readiness checklists, not invented agreements, subprocessors, notices, terms or acceptance controls.
Existing legal/admin publication gates are retained; unapproved legacy policy routes may intentionally remain unavailable.
Core authentication, billing, history, sharing, Images, Projects, Library, Work and Settings service acceptance is owned by the core implementation; this map is not new proof of those operations.
